phases.name: Source Research and Qualification
phases.scope: Planning, source boundaries, REA setup, four foundation strategies and review package. No full implementation.
phases.donors: All 58 pins in SOURCE_CATALOG; actual reusable-module prototype at current main; four additional alternatives explicitly justified.
tasks: Verify owner/canonical main and freeze all donor references.
Inspect selected actual source modules, rights/assets and dependency/runtime boundaries.
Run bounded builds/original tests and REA diagnostics; retain failures and exact inputs.
Produce contracts, provider snapshot, plan and independent Claude handoff.
phases.deps: None. Replaces previous Darzain implementation directive for the current frontier.
phases.accept: All required documents resolve; every recommended donor has exact pin, scope, evidence and unresolved gates; no inferred runtime/security/rights pass.
phases.tests: Mechanical document/link/JSON/provenance verification; bounded donor experiments already recorded. No fabricated model benchmark.
phases.security: No private donor code or secrets in public package; inert source analysis; no expensive tests or unrestricted external code execution.
phases.e2e: Historical real application export/recovery evidence informs the foundation; it is not Yamakan release acceptance.
phases.evidence: Source/module hashes, builds, donor test receipts, REA CLI/MCP receipts, official provider sources and current repository verification.
phases.exit: Package complete for review. Independent Claude review and founder decisions are REQUIRED before P01. Qualification of every GPU/provider remains partial.
phases.risks: Unequal source depth, restricted weights/assets, unqualified native runtimes, evolving provider pages, limited disk/hardware.

phases.name: Foundation and Identity
phases.scope: Approved modular core, coherent Yamakan identity, one data/service authority, desktop boundary and CI.
phases.donors: Bounded filmmaker web modules already qualified; existing main; Ninerr encoding/history concepts; ArtCraft desktop boundary reference. Tauri is proposed, not qualified.
tasks: Record Claude findings and founder decisions; pin approved plan revision.
Rename user-facing product and package namespace while preserving legal provenance; repository rename only by separate explicit decision.
Specify typed command boundary and loopback service ownership; qualify Tauri spike versus Electron fallback with no unrestricted IPC.
Make reproducible build/CI and baseline clean-host launch.
phases.deps: P00 + independent Claude review + recorded founder approval. Production changes cannot start before these.
phases.accept: Offline app launches on supported Windows host without Python/GPU/API key; one canonical store; build reproducible and legacy data discoverable.
phases.tests: Build/type/schema checks; bounded shell file/command ownership checks; CI exact head; launch smoke on a second clean host.
phases.security: Loopback/origin validation; no arbitrary filesystem/shell IPC; CSP and scoped file handles; secret-free logs; no default shared dev secret.
phases.e2e: Launch both web and desktop configurations, choose a local workspace and verify blocked cross-origin/unscoped access.
phases.evidence: Installed artifact/version/hash, build logs, clean-host launch recording and shell adapter permission tests.
phases.exit: Approved foundation actually runs; notices retained; no empty studios exposed; no migration or packaging acceptance claimed by UI branding alone.
phases.risks: Tauri/native toolchain packaging unknown; Electron fallback expands update/security burden; old names in persisted roots require careful migration.

phases.name: Canonical Projects and Assets
phases.scope: Versioned project envelope, immutable asset versions, history, migrations, archives and recovery.
phases.donors: Skelet content-addressed recovery module at qualified pin; Ninerr canonical encoding/history reference; Pluma store patterns evaluated, not a second database authority; OTIO rational-time/interchange reference.
tasks: Define exact schema/operation unions and validate all references and numeric domains.
Implement pure Darzain-to-Yamakan migration into a new root preserving original bytes.
Add stable asset/version/probe/provenance identities and scoped import streaming.
Adapt qualified storage with revision conflicts, bounded undo, recovery and archive publication.
phases.deps: P01; approved PROJECT_DATA_MODEL; independently review current storage limitations before extending.
phases.accept: Semantic and editable migration round-trip; atomic revision publication; corrupt/incomplete roots recover without silent data replacement; archives preserve referenced assets.
phases.tests: Golden schema/migrations; broken refs, unsafe numbers, duplicate IDs; concurrent writers; crash points; case/reparse/traversal/expansion-limit archive corpus.
phases.security: No credentials/absolute host paths in project archives; bounded media and metadata; symlink/reparse protection and corruption preservation.
phases.e2e: Import mixed media, edit/save/undo, close service, restart, recover and export/import an archive; original root unchanged.
phases.evidence: Original/migrated/round-trip hashes, probe metadata, revision journals, injected-crash receipts and malicious-archive rejection logs.
phases.exit: One stable data authority with measured recovery semantics; no data-loss or silent unknown-version downgrade cases open.
phases.risks: Windows directory sync/lock semantics; ambiguous interrupted publication; disk-full failures; future-schema compatibility.

phases.name: First Real Production Vertical Slice
phases.scope: The 12-step offline project/import/scene/shot/timeline/title/audio/preview/export/reopen/API journey. No paid inference dependency.
phases.donors: Qualified filmmaker timeline/preview primitives and FFmpeg integration references; actual installed FFmpeg renderer; owned workspace storage; durable jobs draft is unapproved and requires independent review.
tasks: Review and selectively adapt durable-worker draft; define attempts, restart reconciliation and owned child termination.
Implement shared scene/shot/timeline commands, trim/split, title and audio placement with rational time.
Use frozen revisions for owned FFmpeg export and probe all outputs; preflight unsupported effects.
Repeat same journey through UI and REST/CLI; cancel, restart, reopen and recover.
phases.deps: P02 and minimal scoped command/API surface from P09 planned in parallel; actual preview/export parity contracts.
phases.accept: Real playable MP4 contains expected picture/title/audio and timing; saved edits reopen intact; API produces the same semantic project; zero mandatory cloud compute.
phases.tests: Actual image/video/audio fixtures; trim/title/audio placement frame/sound checks; cancellation races; restart orphan cleanup; fixed output bounds; browser and API tests.
phases.security: Argv-based subprocesses with bounded paths/profiles/time/output; untrusted media quotas; no arbitrary FFmpeg filter/shell input; owned process groups; failed artifacts quarantined.
phases.e2e: All steps in E2E_ACCEPTANCE plus actual close/restart, failed/cancelled attempt recovery, fresh-host offline export and Arabic title shaping fixture.
phases.evidence: MP4/hash/ffprobe/frame/audio checks, project/reopen hash, browser/API trace, process/cancel/restart receipts and clean-host recording.
phases.exit: First real production slice passes exact-head CI and independent implementation review. No placeholder interaction or screenshot substitutes.
phases.risks: Preview/export semantic mismatch; font shaping; VFR/audio rounding; process orphan races; disk pressure and local-server lifecycle.

phases.name: Image and Cinema
phases.scope: Qualified image generation/editing plus bounded scene/camera/light staging linked to one project.
phases.donors: ArtCraft scene/camera/pose; InvokeAI canvas/layers reference; ComfyUI protocol; diffusers optional worker; SAM2/GroundingDINO optional segmentation/detection.
tasks: Translate scene/camera/lighting into canonical entities without inheriting donor state engines.
Provide layers/masks and non-destructive image edits with asset-version lineage.
Qualify one optional local image engine/profile and explicit camera/pose conditioning receipt.
Add measured preview/conditioning/identity tests and unavailable-capability UX.
phases.deps: P03; P05 descriptor/adapter/policy foundation; optional supported hardware/model rights.
phases.accept: Image operations create real editable/versioned outputs; camera input is either an applied supported control with receipt or clearly labeled textual intent; offline scene editing still works without inference.
phases.tests: Mask/layer golden round trips, real bounded image jobs, scene translation fixtures, conditioning mapping and output quality rubric.
phases.security: Custom nodes and model code isolated; no automatic plugin installation; approved egress; safe model loaders; reference consent and credential redaction.
phases.e2e: Stage a scene, place a consented character/reference, edit mask, generate via a qualified engine, compare and import selected take.
phases.evidence: Exact engine/model/weights rights and hashes, hardware report, actual generated images and input/conditioning/quality receipts.
phases.exit: Only qualified operations exposed; source build or GPU detection alone cannot satisfy generation acceptance.
phases.risks: No suitable discrete GPU on current host; incompatible CUDA stacks; weights/asset rights; prompt-only camera control and identity drift.

phases.name: Model Providers and Smart Router
phases.scope: Versioned capabilities, direct and aggregator BYOK adapters, explicit consent, cost quotas and reconciled jobs.
phases.donors: Open Generative AI bounded provider references; official vendor documentation; MiniMax MCP contract reference requiring v2 rewrite; Gomrey pure budget/job rules; Ecra/kernux policy patterns.
tasks: Implement describe/validate/quote/submit/poll/cancel/reconcile/collectOutputs on versioned adapters.
Qualify first founder-selected provider/region/model with user credentials and a capped approved real test.
Implement hard eligibility filters before ranking, decimal reservations and price freshness.
Persist remote task receipts; do not auto-repeat ambiguous chargeable submissions or silently switch providers.
phases.deps: P03 job/data semantics; P04 can use shared adapter scaffold without all cloud adapters being ready.
phases.accept: Unsupported parameters fail before spend; offline/BYOK have no founder key dependency; max budget is enforced under declared billing bounds; every charged attempt has receipt/reconciliation state.
phases.tests: Fake-provider contract/fault tests plus approved capped real tests per enabled model; quote/input surcharge/rounding/rate/expiry tests; multi-provider cancellation semantics.
phases.security: Secret storage outside project; scoped network consent and region policy; SSRF validation on upload/download; no secret echoes or cross-workspace credentials.
phases.e2e: Configure own key, review quote/media disclosure, submit/cancel/reconcile, import actual output; remove key and confirm no fallback to founder capacity.
phases.evidence: Official doc/account/model revision, redacted task IDs and usage/cost receipts, output hashes, actual entitlement/region/cancellation behavior.
phases.exit: Enable only tested/entitled capabilities; retired/unknown models disabled; all commercial resale functions gated separately.
phases.risks: Public docs change; missing hard billing cap; uploaded-media retention; unresolved regional eligibility; input charges and ambiguous remote retries.

phases.name: Director and Storyboard
phases.scope: Script, versioned characters, brand references, shot planning, take review and measured continuity.
phases.donors: OpenMontage production manifests/stage gates; OpenVideoStudio identity metadata; StoryMind planner references; filmmaker director/storyboard; Morize memory types.
tasks: Convert script to validated proposed scene/shot plans with human review before generation.
Version character/brand references and applied conditioning lineage.
Adapt OpenMontage stage prerequisites to Yamakan jobs and persist approvals/artifacts.
Measure multi-shot continuity and invalidate caches/takes after reference changes.
phases.deps: P02/P03 entities and P04/P05 qualified generation; memory retrieval optional and version filtered.
phases.accept: A script creates an editable storyboard; references and approvals survive restart; no identity claim without measurable generated outputs and consent.
phases.tests: Original donor prerequisite/identity tests plus adapter tests; adversarial prompt/plan validation; cache invalidation; blind continuity evaluation.
phases.security: Treat script/reference metadata and LLM output as untrusted proposals; no prompt-derived privileges or automatic external uploads; consent for likeness/voice.
phases.e2e: Plan three scenes with one character, approve shots, generate qualified takes, reject/regenerate a take, assemble and reopen editable production.
phases.evidence: Versioned script/refs, approved plan, stage job receipts, real multi-shot outputs, continuity rubric and human ratings.
phases.exit: Resumable production passes actual interruption/review flow; no claim that metadata fixtures prove video identity.
phases.risks: Identity drift and narrative quality; model limitations; OpenMontage external tools/durability and AGPL obligations; no strong measured continuity baseline yet.

phases.name: Video, Motion, 3D, and Audio
phases.scope: Incrementally qualified advanced media controls. Each engine/operation independently gated.
phases.donors: Wan2GP/diffusers/LTX-2/HunyuanVideo/FramePack/Wan-Move; LivePortrait/LatentSync; Blender/R3F/Hunyuan3D/TRELLIS; faster-whisper/Piper; RIFE/Real-ESRGAN; MLT/Remotion optional workers.
tasks: Prioritize one video and one audio workflow using approved hardware/rights; keep other engines disabled until measured.
Add versioned motion/pose/reference mapping and explicit native-audio separation.
Add transcription/subtitles/lip-sync and optional 3D staging/import through isolated worker contracts.
Qualify codec/effects/interchange/renderer parity before professional options are advertised.
phases.deps: P04–P06 and suitable environments/assets; no mandatory GPU/Python for core launch.
phases.accept: Each exposed operation returns probed real outputs, correct references and cancellation/recovery receipts; incompatible hardware yields a useful disabled reason.
phases.tests: Real bounded model jobs, camera/motion obedience, audio alignment/Arabic intelligibility, 3D mesh/resource checks, interpolation/upscale artifact evaluation; renderer golden parity.
phases.security: Worker resource isolation; safe weight loading; likeness/voice controls; no arbitrary JSX/Python in trusted host; bound mesh/textures and model downloads.
phases.e2e: A qualified operation contributes media to the same editable timeline and actual export; restart/cancel and offline editing stay functional.
phases.evidence: Per-engine environment/weights/license/hardware receipts, outputs, quality judgments, latency/memory/cost and failure cases.
phases.exit: Per-operation acceptance, not a blanket all-model pass. Unsupported models remain candidates in inventory.
phases.risks: Current host lacks verified suitable GPU; community/territorial/weight conditions; Python/CUDA conflict; audio/face consent; performance and severe hallucinated control compliance.

phases.name: Workflow Automation and Ads
phases.scope: Declarative reusable workflows, batch runs, brand/product references, ad variants and social-format exports.
phases.donors: xyflow graph UI; OpenMontage stage schemas; Gomrey pure rules; Open Generative AI marketing references; MoneyPrinterTurbo workflow concepts, without silent cloud/stock/publishing defaults.
tasks: Implement typed nodes/edges with dependency validation and durable per-node jobs.
Add brand kits, consented product/reference assets and reusable composition templates.
Produce bounded batches with per-run/spend/resource limits and review loops.
Export editable variants in qualified aspect/resolution formats; publication remains separate explicit action.
phases.deps: P03 timeline/render; P05 budget/adapter; P06 continuity; selected P07 operations as optional nodes.
phases.accept: Graph UI and agent API execute the same registered node definitions; interrupted batches resume without duplicate spend; brand lineage and selected takes remain editable.
phases.tests: Cycle/type/budget/branch tests; deterministic pure nodes; retry/restart/cancellation; template/export comparisons; misleading stock/brand-reference tests.
phases.security: No eval/dynamic donor scripts; no privileged workflow-injected nodes; references and assets have rights; social posting/stock downloads need explicit authorization.
phases.e2e: Run an approved campaign brief into three variants, interrupt/resume, review outputs and export social formats without publication.
phases.evidence: Graph schema/version, node receipts, batch budget, actual variant exports and reference/provenance record.
phases.exit: Actual resumable workflow, not xyflow graph drawing alone; no silent stock/TTS/upload/network.
phases.risks: Graph UI mistaken for scheduler; duplicate charge/retry; brand drift; rights; autogenerated claims/content; template rendering parity.

phases.name: Agent-Native Platform
phases.scope: Shared scoped commands exposed through MCP, REST, CLI and typed TS/Python SDKs; minimal subset shipped in first slice.
phases.donors: Ninerr MCP/session patterns; Orcel input queue/tool boundaries; Ascout independence rules; Ecra budget/recovery and kernux policies. Reject Kodac dev-secret fallback as authentication.
tasks: Define one typed tool/command schema, errors, progress and audit contract.
Ship minimal project/import/scene/timeline/render/job/reopen tools with P03.
Add SDKs and discovery/resource scopes; MCP stdio first, remote auth later.
Add durable agent proposals with reviewable operations and least privilege.
phases.deps: P01/P02 contracts; MVP subset alongside P03; full platform after P05/P08 scopes mature.
phases.accept: Agents complete the first slice without browser clicks; permissions/expectedRevision/requestId are identical across interfaces; SDKs never embed credentials in project.
phases.tests: Schema/codegen parity, structured-error contract, authorization denial, retries/idempotency, disconnect/progress/cancel and CLI actual output tests.
phases.security: Separate transport identity from project scopes; stdio session boundary; remote OAuth/auth before exposure; no shared dev fallback; audit without secrets or forged tool-output authority.
phases.e2e: Standalone agent/client creates and exports/reopens production, loses connection, resumes and cancels owned work through tools.
phases.evidence: Tool schema/version, SDK examples, API/MCP/CLI transcripts, denied calls and identical semantic outputs.
phases.exit: Minimal parity is an MVP requirement, full permissioned SDK platform a v1 gate; source patterns are not proof of runtime safety.
phases.risks: Transport auth complexity; task ownership; context injection; overlapping permission models; unfinished owner runtimes.

phases.name: Quality, Security, and Performance
phases.scope: Quality Lab benchmarks, adversarial resource/security/recovery checks and measured supported limits; starts alongside each phase.
phases.donors: Ascout/SpecGrain evidence/independence contracts; Diffcipline bounded harness concepts; Jev secondary judgments; independent review tools when operational, never substituted passes.
tasks: Build reproducible consented workload/output benchmarks and blind human evaluation.
Attack archives/media/SSRF/plugin/workflow/scopes/cost boundaries with bounded fixtures.
Measure CPU/GPU/disk/memory/preview/export/cancel/reopen distributions and set supported limits.
Resolve severe independent-review findings and document residual risk by actual release scope.
phases.deps: Cross-cutting P01 onward; full benchmark engine set from enabled P04–P09 operations only.
phases.accept: No unresolved release-blocking security/data-loss/billing defects; measured supported limits and honest unavailable operations; quality results reproducible with artifact provenance.
phases.tests: Adversarial corpus, crash injection, fuzz/property checks on critical serialization/time/money, load/cancel/restart distributions, accessibility/RTL/Arabic export.
phases.security: Threat-based tests and independent review; tool unavailable/failure states are explicit; protect consented datasets and secrets in evidence.
phases.e2e: Repeat full production journeys under disk pressure, cancellation, interrupted jobs and malicious input; verify no data loss or unauthorized network/spend.
phases.evidence: Exact patch/test hashes, fresh independent judgments, resource distributions, quality outputs/ratings and triaged findings.
phases.exit: Release-scope checks pass with evidence; do not require unused unqualified GPU engines or accept static audits as E2E.
phases.risks: Insufficient independent provider tooling; narrow fixtures; tiny benchmark samples; misleading automated creative scores; resource limitations.

phases.name: Release Qualification
phases.scope: Supported desktop and local web delivery, clean installation/update/recovery, offline operation, documentation and notices.
phases.donors: Approved bounded source modules only; established render/media libraries; qualified shell/update patterns, not copied complete donor application installers.
tasks: Build signed/versioned artifacts where signing is available; document any unsigned preview limitation.
Test clean-host install, offline first slice, update/rollback and legacy project migration.
Verify Arabic/English navigation, text shaping/accessibility and API/SDK guide against actual release.
Freeze SBOM/provenance/notices, qualification matrix and supported capability limits.
phases.deps: MVP: P01–P03 + minimal P09 + scoped P10. Production v1: enabled P04–P09 + P10. Never advertise all inventory as released.
phases.accept: User downloads/install/launches without founder cloud, paid inference, Python or GPU for editing; actual export/reopen works; update does not overwrite data.
phases.tests: Clean Windows host plus separately qualified web browser; install/uninstall without user-data deletion; offline network capture; full UI/API journeys; migration/update rollback.
phases.security: Integrity/signature and update-source checks; permission-minimal installer; secrets not bundled; dependency/notices and codec-build compliance.
phases.e2e: Fresh supported-host installation executes entire first slice and programmatic repeat; production-v1 adds only qualified creative/provider workflows.
phases.evidence: Artifact hash/build commit, install recording, actual MP4/project, offline network report, notices/SBOM, support matrix and rollback receipt.
phases.exit: Independent release review and founder ship decision against concrete artifacts; no claim desktop delivery from a web preview.
phases.risks: Signing/distribution/toolchain gaps; FFmpeg build-specific GPL/nonfree components; untested OS/browser/media combinations; update migration safety.

firstTenTasks: Record independent Claude review, reconcile findings and obtain founder approval for foundation/schema/license/runtime/MVP decisions; freeze reviewed plan commit.
Create implementation branch from the approved base; establish Yamakan user-facing identity, source notices, reproducible build/CI and bounded shell/API ownership.
Specify and implement pure legacy-project migration into a new root using rational time and canonical serialization; retain original bytes and hashes.
Implement immutable asset-version imports, media probes, stable project references, provenance and explicit rights/consent metadata.
Independently review the preserved durable-jobs draft; adapt only accepted pieces into canonical attempt/ownership/cancellation semantics.
Qualify stale-lock, orphan-worker, disk-full and interrupted-publication recovery on Windows; add ambiguous provider-submit state without automatic rebilling.
Implement and qualify bounded archive export/import with manifests, hashes, no secrets, traversal/reparse/case/expansion rejection and recovery preservation.
Connect scene/shot/timeline trim/split/title/audio commands to one state engine and actual preview; qualify timing and Arabic text shaping.
Render a frozen revision with an owned FFmpeg process through UI and API; validate actual MP4 picture, title, audio and cancellation outputs.
Run clean-host offline launch/import/edit/export, service close/restart/reopen and programmatic repeat; publish exact-head evidence and independently review the first slice.
